audience: managers of shops, restaurants and other hourly teams who schedule staff in Homebase

useCases.title: See who is scheduled to work
useCases.text: The AI lists the shifts of a location in a date range with employee, role, start, end and open or published state. It can show only open shifts.

useCases.title: Check labor cost by day, role or employee
useCases.text: The AI reads aggregate labor for a location and date range: hours, overtime, cost and tips, grouped by day, hour, role or employee.

useCases.title: Review timecards before payroll
useCases.text: The AI lists timecards with clock in and out, breaks, hours, labor cost, tips and approval state, and adds the hours per employee.

useCases.title: Check if an employee is clocked in
useCases.text: The AI reads the time-clock state of an employee's job: clocked in, on break or clocked out, with the current shift.

useCases.title: Look up employees, roles and wage rates
useCases.text: The AI lists the employees of a location with contact details, default role, additional roles, wage type and rate, and payroll id.

useCases.title: Find shifts and timecards that were deleted
useCases.text: The AI lists the ids of shifts or timecards deleted in a date range, with their times and when they were deleted.
